verdict.rationale: DBOS docs show building blocks for workflow composition — DBOS.start_workflow to launch sub-workflows and retrieve results (fan-out/fan-in), and queues for running many workflows concurrently with managed concurrency (dynamic batch fan-out) — all without a separate orchestrator, per dbos-docs-5, dbos-docs-6, dbos-gh-1. However, the evidence never explicitly documents a 'child workflow' abstraction, a fan-in/aggregation pattern, or dynamic batch-size handling by name, so the specific patterns in the story are only partially evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit child-workflow API/semantics, documented fan-in aggregation pattern, and dynamic-batch fan-out example or tutorial.
